requirements.quote:
Packetization Layer (PL).  A QUIC sender can therefore enter the
   DPLPMTUD BASE state (Section 5.2 of [DPLPMTUD]) when the QUIC
   connection handshake has been completed.
requirements.condition: The QUIC connection handshake has been completed.
requirements.required_behavior: A QUIC sender is permitted to enter the DPLPMTUD BASE state.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-transition test can complete the QUIC handshake and verify that the sender permits transition into the DPLPMTUD BASE state.
